summary: Scope: deterministic implementation-acceptance evidence for one explicit execution-plans/<target>; no target-code implementation, approval, commit, release, deploy, or archive; modes evidence_only (default) and controlled_validation; require frozen baseline, candidate custody/content manifests, implementation contract or compact-vdd prerequisite bundle, typed request, action DAG, command registry, acceptance knowledge context, and ready Skill-input receipt; never infer scope/revisions/paths/commands/actions or enumerate dirty worktree; use Quick Dev receipt/projection for implementation-complete targets; create hash-bound artifacts and append-only binding-derived runs, preserving stale predecessors and legacy artifact-only runs; canonical Locator only, catalog_stale is degraded/non-authorizing, other knowledge failures route repair-required; validate/refresh read-set without widening selection; start-or-resume requires canonical inputHash, contract/context hashes, Skill-input receipt/contract; deterministic actions replay controlled receipts and finalize only complete exact DAG; default deterministic_only bypasses Bootstrap; required semantic routes require inspect-lineage, prepare-bootstrap, typed route, explicit high-cost acknowledgement and run-phase-bootstrap-review; later discovery needs recommendation/confidence and explicit user confirmation; routes: deterministic_only, focused_repair_verification, full_implementation_conformance, manual_pause; maintenanceMode ai-native-single-maintainer; P2 closes deterministically, P0/P1 requires Quick Dev handoff and repair-completeness; max three semantic rounds, no Round 4; manual-pause closure uses ADR-0054 two-stage deterministic protocol with exact mappings, receipts, authorities, finalized protocol review, acknowledgement, and final closure only; exact Bootstrap reuse only v3 with current hashes, clean finalized run, immediate lineage predecessor/head and matching attestation; historical v1/v2 reuse non-authorizing; model routing is no-launch except policy-owned complex recovery triggers; malformed transport retries same round; pure Godot unsupported; Phase/toolchain policies selected by candidate domain; coverage uses changed executable PhaseA.Platform/**/*.cs lines and Cobertura; checklist/matrix/evidence references must be current and hash-bound; caller descriptors, requirements, profiles, risk/reason codes, hand-authored routes/rounds, unpublished inputs, live workspace substitutes, and uncovered paths fail closed.
